objectives: "The aim of this course is to provide students general knowledge of information retrieval. The first part focuses on the basic concept and theory of information retrieval. In particular, text processing techniques for document indexing, classification, and clustering are introduced. In addition, query techniques and evaluation methods are covered. Finally, machine learning in information retrieval will be discussed. For the second part, several important research topics in information retrieval will be considered. Specifically, related research papers in these topics will be present."
content:
"Part I: Basic Concepts (* 18 Chapters)
1 Course Introduction
2 Information Retrieval: An Introduction and Some Research Issues
3 Text Processing I (Ch 2 & Ch 3)
4 Text Processing II (Ch 6 & Ch 7)
5 Evaluation and Relevance Feedback (Ch 8 & Ch 9)
6 Text Classification (Ch 13, Ch 14 & Ch 15)
7 Text Clustering (Ch 16 & Ch 17)
8 Web Search (Ch 10, Ch 19 & Ch 20)
9 Mid-term exam
Part II: Research Topics (* 20 papers)
10 Text categorization
11 Text clustering
12 Recommender systems
13 Web Search and Mining
14 HCI in Information Retrieval
15 Evaluation in Information Retrieval
16 Information retrieval applications I (放假)
17 Information retrieval applications II
18 Final exam"
